name: fraser-coho-2023-2024
title: Fraser River coho salmon natural adult spawner estimates, 2023-2024
description: Estimates of natural adult coho salmon (Oncorhynchus kisutch) spawners for 87 Fraser River populations in DFO sub-districts 29F, 29G, 29J and 29K, analysis years 2023 and 2024: 173 records from the DFO New Salmon Escapement Database System (NuSEDS), each with the estimate method, estimate classification, estimate stage and stream-inspection window behind it. The metasalmon gold-standard Salmon Data Package.

resources.name: escapement

fields.name: POP_ID
fields.title: Population ID
fields.description: NuSEDS identifier of the population the record is for.

fields.name: POPULATION
fields.title: Population name
fields.description: NuSEDS population name. Inherited from earlier databases, it is by default a concatenation of stream name, sub-district, species and run type, for example Bonaparte River (Lillooet) Coho.

fields.name: AREA
fields.title: Sub-district
fields.description: DFO Pacific Region sub-district recorded for the population. NuSEDS defines AREA as the subdistrict, which in most cases is the same as the statistical area; the two differ mainly for streams that drain to the Fraser and for large areas split into lettered parts, such as 29F. These are the sub-districts of the NuSEDS Map of Areas, not Pacific Fishery Management Areas or Subareas.

fields.name: WATERBODY
fields.title: Waterbody
fields.description: Name of the waterbody, or the portion of a waterbody, that bounds the population.

fields.name: ANALYSIS_YR
fields.title: Analysis year
fields.description: The year the estimate is for. Surveys may have continued into the following calendar year.

fields.name: SPECIES
fields.title: Species
fields.description: Species of fish, as its NuSEDS common name.

fields.name: RUN_TYPE
fields.title: Run type
fields.description: Run timing of the population's run within the season. NuSEDS names a run (for example FALL) where documentation supports it, and numbers it (1) where documentation shows only that there are distinct runs within a season. Blank where NuSEDS records none.

fields.name: NATURAL_ADULT_SPAWNERS
fields.title: Natural adult spawners
fields.description: Estimated number of natural adult spawners: salmon that have reached maturity, excluding jacks (salmon that matured at an early age). Natural spawners are counted apart from artificial spawners such as hatchery broodstock; the word describes where the fish spawn, not their origin. Blank where no estimate was made.

fields.name: ESTIMATE_METHOD
fields.title: Estimate method
fields.description: Standard NuSEDS method used to produce the estimate.

fields.name: ESTIMATE_CLASSIFICATION
fields.title: Estimate classification
fields.description: Classification of the estimate by its accuracy and precision, from Type-1, the most accurate, to Type-6, the least.

fields.name: ESTIMATE_STAGE
fields.title: Estimate stage
fields.description: Review stage of the estimate: preliminary, near final or final.

fields.name: START_DTT
fields.title: Inspection start date
fields.description: Date the first stream inspection for this season's estimate started.

fields.name: END_DTT
fields.title: Inspection end date
fields.description: Date the last stream inspection for this season's estimate started.

fields.name: WATERSHED_CDE
fields.title: Watershed code
fields.description: 45-digit hierarchical provincial watershed code, derived from the province's 1:50,000 National Topographic Series map sheets and unique to the waterbody and its watershed; its 12 levels follow the hierarchy of the stream network.

resources.title: Coho escapement estimates
resources.description: One row per NuSEDS escapement record: a coho population, the waterbody that bounds it and an analysis year, with the natural adult spawner estimate and the method, classification, stage and inspection window behind it.
